mapper.select: SELECT r.* FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.id=ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id=#{userId} AND ur.deleted=FALSE ORDER BY r.id
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user_role SET deleted=TRUE WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND role_id=#{roleId} AND deleted=FALSE
UPDATE sys_user SET version=version+1,auth_version=auth_version+1,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,updated_by=#{actor} WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND deleted=FALSE
